title: 京都大賞典の後に・実り

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wins the race her way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only did she run without a hitch, she ran more powerfully than ever before. All of her training has paid off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, it's time for the autumn Tenno Sho! It's time to take on Mejiro McQueen and Kitasan Black!
